name: @projexlight/sdk-content
summary: Structured content + taxonomy for ProjexCloud: item types (article, snippet, page, faq), versioning, taxonomy-tag composition, publish workflow. Foundation for any marketing site, knowledge base, or content-driven journey step (sdk-campaign embeds content items as template body sources).

endpoints.description: Fetch a content item + active version + tags.
Create a new version (auto-saved as draft).
Retire a version; URL returns 410 going forward.
Create or update a taxonomy (set of tags).
Apply or remove taxonomy tags on a content item.

events.name: content.published.v1
events.description: Version promoted to published; clients should bust caches.

events.name: content.taxonomy.changed.v1
events.description: Taxonomy edited; carries diff of added / removed tags.

models.description: Content item: slug, kind, owner_persona, taxonomies, current_published_version.

hooks.name: createItem
hooks.description: Create a content item in draft state.

hooks.name: addVersion
hooks.description: Add a new version (always starts as draft).

hooks.name: publishVersion
hooks.description: Atomically promote a version to published; previous published transitions to superseded.

hooks.name: retireVersion
hooks.description: Retire a version; future fetches 410 Gone.

hooks.name: applyTags
hooks.description: Apply or remove taxonomy tags on a content item.

scenarios.title: Marketer drafts a new blog article
scenarios.when_to_use: First-time author flow. Create the item; first version starts as draft; preview link works immediately, public URL stays 404 until publish.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Item + version (draft) rows. Emits .item.created.v1 + .version.created.v1. Preview URL serves the draft; public URL returns 404.

scenarios.title: Publish gated by sdk-approval (compliance review)
scenarios.when_to_use: Regulated tenant: every publish needs compliance approval. Reactive on approval.request.approved.v1 — when the approval clears, auto-publish the gated version.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Version promoted; emits .published.v1. CDN cache busted. Public URL serves the new content.

scenarios.title: Tag article with multiple taxonomies
scenarios.when_to_use: Marketing wants the article surfaced under multiple categories — 'data-residency', 'eu', 'enterprise'. applyTags writes the join rows + emits .taxonomy.changed.v1.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Tags applied; emits .taxonomy.changed.v1. sdk-search re-indexes the item with the new tags.

scenarios.title: Retire an article that's compliance-out-of-date
scenarios.when_to_use: Article no longer reflects current regulations; retire it so search + nav can't surface it.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Version status='retired'. Future GETs 410 Gone. sdk-search drops it from the index.

scenarios.title: sdk-campaign references a content item as journey-step body
scenarios.when_to_use: Marketing journey step 'send-email' references content.item.slug='eu-q3-pro-tier'; the journey executor pulls the current published version at send time so updates propagate without republishing the journey.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Email body = current published version body. If content author publishes a new version mid-journey, future sends pick it up; in-flight scheduled sends use whichever version was current when the step started.

compliance_posture.notes: Every publish + retire pinned to persona + reason → DSA takedown trail. Versions retained for CONTENT_SUPERSEDED_RETENTION_DAYS so a regulator can replay 'what did this URL show on date X'. Retired-410 (not 404) preserves the takedown signal vs. a missing-page signal.
